title: Peter Thiel on “The Straussian Moment”
summary: Peter Robinson interviews Peter Thiel at the Hoover Institution about Thiel's essay The Straussian Moment. Thiel discusses how people trust the will more than the intellect and reason, and how the question of human nature has been abandoned.
why: HN points to it as a primer on Thiel's thinking and as an example of Peter Robinson's skill as an interviewer.

quote.text: There is a Peter Robinson interview about the essay that can serve as a good primer[1].
